svg.title: One run of research-graph-v1
svg.desc: Animated walk through the research graph: the planner fans out to parallel scouts, a join records their results in plan order, gap analysis fans out to deep dives, the synthesizer writes a report, the verifier checks it, and one verification round loops back before the run ends.
svg.text: nodes light up as they run; dots are typed values moving between steps
append-only, in plan order; claim IDs like q2/c1
← scouts, then deep dives, in plan order

g.text: The planner splits the objective into research questions.
Scouts research every question in parallel: map() fans out, a semaphore bounds it.
They finish in any order (q2 first). The join waits; a serial step records q1, q2, q3.
Gap analysis names weak spots; the most severe gap per question gets a deep dive.
Deep dives fan out and join the same way. Workers return values; they never write state.
The synthesizer writes a report that may cite only ledger claim IDs.
The verifier checks the report claim by claim and may ask for follow-ups.
Follow-ups buy another round while rounds remain: deep dives, then synthesize again.
Verified again, the run ends with its report, verification, and review_reasons.
